primitive.relation: two separate public views of GTBase.walk_usage, with no identification between them. Finite undirected pair occurrence: GTMisc.D7.walk_uses s p u v is seq_consecutiveb (s :: p) u v by conversion, the Boolean form of B3's GTBase.walks_paths.seq_consecutive (same body with || for \/, reflected by seq_consecutivebP, equal to MathComp's infix test by seq_consecutivebE): u and v are adjacent entries of s :: p in either order; no edge, nonempty-walk, uniqueness, distinct-endpoint or terminal premise; an empty tail uses nothing and a repeated adjacent value uses its loop pair. Alternating oriented usage: Infinite.D4inf4.walk_uses b x p a c is alt_uses b x p a c over the vertex Type of an iDigraph (an explicit iff by induction): some step of x :: p, read with polarity b flipping at every step, is (a, c) in its current orientation; Prop with propositional equality, no arc, no alt_walk_from validity, no eqType, choice or inhabitance. On an eqType carrier alt_uses implies consecutive occurrence (alt_uses_consecutive); the converse fails. Distinct and untouched: Cycle.D1.edp_feasible, an edge-labelled multigraph routing homonym of a D7 chain name.

finite-undirected-pair.note: public contract GTBase.walk_usage.seq_consecutiveb, the Boolean view of B3's seq_consecutive (B3 keeps its ownership and declarations); D7's MaxEDP chain (edp_feasible, edp_opt, edp_ratio_spec, maxedp_approx) and row are frozen over it with both feasibility clauses, the Wagner guard and the same program for realization and cost.

alternating-oriented.note: public contract GTBase.walk_usage.alt_uses over an arbitrary Type; D4inf4's universal chain and row are frozen over it with the same b, x, p witnessing alternating validity and both usages, and the three nonvacuity guards kept.

upstream_audit.note: No named upstream predicate matches either view. MathComp's infix gives the finite test's value (seq_consecutivebE) and B3's seq_consecutive is its Prop contract, reused rather than enrolled; GraphTheory's multigraph walks are edge-labelled sequences, not the arbitrary-Type alternating raw vertex recurrence. GTBase.walk_usage is not re-exported by GTBase.base.
